lane_role: MANDATORY axis: realized-inflation PPP-deviation misalignment, outcome-blind proposal 2 of 2 (preregistered variant of the census class: 12m horizon + z-standardization)
title: 12m realized-inflation PPP-deviation state, z-standardized hysteresis: the fast band of the mandate-cycle reversion on the funded pairs
mechanism: Who is slow/forced: the same valuation-motivated cohort as proposal-1 (reserve managers, sovereign funds, corporate treasurers), but sampled at the FASTER band of their mandate cycle: fiscal-year hedge-ratio resets are set off 1-year realized purchasing-power gaps, quarterly reserve-flow valuation marks flag 1-year real misalignments, and monthly mandate reviews act on the deviation scaled by its own recent dispersion (a 1-sigma move in the gap is a review trigger, a raw 36m gap is not). Why the effect exists: over 12 months, the spot return minus the 12m relative-CPI change measures how far spot has drifted from the price-level anchor within one budget cycle; when that gap is extreme relative to its own trailing dispersion, budget-cycle flow (hedge-ratio resets, valuation-mark rebalancing) pushes back over the following 1-2 print cycles. The mechanism is MEAN-REVERSION IN THE DEVIATION, not trend-following: the traded signal is z(m) where m = 12m nominal spot return MINUS 12m relative CPI — when the inflation differential explains the nominal trend, m ~= 0 and z(m) ~= 0 and NO trade fires even though a large nominal trend exists; the standardization is computed on the DEVIATION stream, never on the trend stream, so the anchor cannot collapse onto the V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow (PF 1.2268) by construction. Observable: per pair, m_p(t) = log(S_p(t)/S_p(t-12m)) - [cumulative 12m log CPI change of the non-US leg minus the US leg] (one y/y log step per leg per snapshot), each leg consumed as-of the decision instant from the vintaged channel at pinned announcement instants; z over the trailing 8 decision-event snapshots of the pair's own deviation stream (min 6 valid). When it MUST fail: (i) if the identical geometry on the nominal 12m trend alone (misalignment removed — the mandatory control) reproduces the anchor's expectancy (same sign, >= 0.5x), the state is nominal-trend exposure in new words — the V8 death (F2-a); (ii) if pooled |rho| of the anchor state vs the V8 d2 schedules or the nominal-trend field exceeds 0.20 at D2, it dies before scoring; (iii) if the +7d sham-calendar reproduces the anchor (same sign, >= 0.5x), the print timing carries no information (F2-b); (iv) if the 12m gap is a random walk at the decision horizon (no 1-2-cycle reversion), the fade expectancy is non-positive and the frozen gates fail; (v) if the z-window's min-6-valid rule voids too many eligible decision instants (thin quarterly streams), the cell is BLOCKED_SELECTION — a selection failure, not mechanism evidence (F2-c); (vi) if trade counts are too thin to clear the 6 bps round-trip tier-2.0 cost, the break-even gate fails structurally.

fields.field: ppp_misalignment_12m_variant (preregistered 12m-horizon derivative of the census ppp_misalignment_36m class: same legs, same y/y-chain machinery, window 36m -> 12m)
fields.role: anchor mechanism-bearing state (the z-standardized DEVIATION, never the trend)

fields.field: nominal_12m_trend (horizon-matched analog of the census nominal_36m_trend_control field; variant axis declared)
fields.role: MANDATORY causal-control input (plan 2(b)): log(spot[t]/spot[t-12m]) alone — the misalignment removed; D2 measures this control DIRECTLY against the V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow (PF 1.2268) and the nominal-trend field

transforms.as_of_single_snapshot: each decision consumes ONE as-of snapshot per leg: the vintaged observation whose available_time <= the decision instant; no splicing across snapshots/vintages; the 12m relative CPI is ONE y/y log step per leg (log CPI[m]/CPI[m-12], 12 quarterly steps telescoped analogously for AU/NZ legs) computed inside that one snapshot
transforms.rebase_safety: the y/y ratio is invariant to index rebasing within a vintage; cross-rebase pairs guarded by the inherited V8 rebase/revision event map (GB 5 rebase-class; CA 5 rebase-class + 216 revision events; AU rebase inside S0 at vintage 2018-10-09; NZ revised-class samples)
transforms.z_standardization: z_p(t) = m_p(t) / stdev(m_p over the pair's own trailing 8 DECISION-EVENT snapshots, min 6 valid, else NO-DECISION that instant); the window contains only strictly-past decision-instant values of the DEVIATION stream (PIT-clean); the standardization is never computed on the nominal-trend stream for the anchor
transforms.lags_policy: each CPI leg consumed at its own availability instant; the binding instant for a pair is the LATER of (non-US leg instant, US leg instant); I/Q availability-lag mutation must move the consumed decision exactly one period per field

decision_clock.spec: per pair: the FIRST daily 16:00 America/New_York (DST-correct) clock STRICTLY AFTER the LATER leg availability instant of the binding CPI print pair (pinned calendars GB aad19697 / CA_v3 0f1a9328 / AU 42a4e4a3 / NZ 62f82c23; US leg availability = vintaged realtime_start instant); FX 24/5; the book is event-driven on this per-pair grid — entries, hysteresis exits and forced exits evaluated ONLY at these instants (daily-or-slower satisfied); fills at that instant's 16:00-NY close

warmup.reserved_lookback: 12 months of spot history for the state + 8 decision-event snapshots (min 6) for the z-window

warmup.usable_grid: approximately 2021-10-01..2025-07-24 pooled (per-pair first-feasible; S0 tail-capped); exact decision counts bind at runner runtime (spot-dependent; census counts_note)

entry_exit_fills.entry: at a per-pair decision instant, when no position is open in that pair, z_p is valid (>= 6 window values) and |z_p| >= 1.00: SHORT the pair instrument if z_p > 0, LONG if z_p < 0; fill = that instant's 16:00-NY close
entry_exit_fills.exit: hysteresis close at the first subsequent decision instant with |z_p| <= 0.50; otherwise forced close at the 2nd decision instant after entry (max_hold_decision_events = 2); no discretionary exits; positions never overlap within a pair
entry_exit_fills.fills: same-instant market fill at the daily 16:00-NY close; no intrabar logic; no slippage model beyond the cost ladder
entry_exit_fills.dual_book: price-only book and financing-adjusted book carried per frozen invariant 6 (sign non-inversion {0,1} vs 0.0)

costs.note: tier 2.0 PRIMARY for all gate evaluation (inherited V6/V7/V8); round-trip tier-2.0 cost = 6 bps; frozen rule 5: break_even_bps <= 1.5 floor

anchor.spec: 12m deviation z-hysteresis fade on all 4 funded pairs: at each per-pair decision instant, |z| >= 1.00 triggers SHORT instrument (z > 0) or LONG instrument (z < 0); hysteresis exit |z| <= 0.50; forced exit at the 2nd decision instant after entry; equal risk per pair; dual books
anchor.mechanism_bearing_component: the z-standardized DEVIATION m = 12m spot return MINUS 12m relative CPI — standardized on the deviation stream itself, so a nominal trend fully explained by inflation cannot generate a trigger

neighbour.type: MANDATORY +7d sham-calendar placebo, occupying the neighbour slot (print instants condition the book; 3-arm budget; V8 precedent FXFV8-A4-P2)
neighbour.spec: IDENTICAL rule in every field — same z thresholds (1.00/0.50), same 8-event window min 6, same 2-event forced hold, same direction convention, same universe, same dual books — except the per-pair decision calendar is shifted +7 calendar days: entries/exits evaluated at instants+7d, state and z re-computed as-of those shifted instants under identical availability semantics, fills at the shifted instants' 16:00-NY closes
neighbour.tests: whether the GENUINE print timing/values carry the information (falsification cluster #10/#12); the +7d shift also perturbs which leg is the binding later leg at calendar boundaries, so a reproducing sham is strong evidence the conditioning is generic

control.type: causal control — MANDATORY nominal-exposure form (plan 2(b), p3 mandatories_per_family)
control.spec: identical rule geometry with the misalignment removed: input n_p(t) = log(S_p(t)/S_p(t-12m)) alone (horizon-matched analog of the census nominal_36m_trend_control field), z-standardized on its OWN trailing 8-decision-event stream (min 6 valid), same bands |z_n| >= 1.00 / exit <= 0.50, same fade direction convention (z_n > 0 -> SHORT instrument), same event grid, same 2-event forced hold, same universe and dual books
control.identifiability: differs from the anchor ONLY in the mechanism-bearing input (the relative-CPI leg is deleted; the z-window then standardizes the bare trend stream); on decision instants where the CPI differential offsets the nominal trend the anchor stands aside while the control trades — that overlap asymmetry is exactly the refutation surface
control.refutes: the convenient explanation 'this is just nominal price-trend / V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow exposure relabelled' — D2 measures this control DIRECTLY against the V8 shadow (PF 1.2268) and the nominal-trend field

falsification_rule.primary_numeric: F2-a NOMINAL SHADOW: if the control arm's financing-adjusted expectancy per trade at tier 2.0 has the SAME SIGN as the anchor's AND |exp_control| >= 0.5 x |exp_anchor|, the family DIES as nominal-price-trend exposure in new words (V8 R1-class; falsification-by-control cluster instance)
secondary_numeric: F2-b SHAM REPRODUCTION: if the +7d sham neighbour's fin-adj expectancy at tier 2.0 has the anchor's sign AND >= 0.5 x the anchor's, the genuine print timing carries no incremental information -> family DIES

F2-c DIRECTION REFUTATION: if anchor expectancy at tier 2.0 < 0 while the control expectancy > 0, the mean-reversion direction is refuted at the 12m horizon -> family DIES; a sign flip is FORBIDDEN as rescue

F2-d ANCESTRY VETO (measured at D2 pre-selection, before any PnL): pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the anchor's conditioning state and ANY forbidden-ancestry exposure — including the V8 d2 schedules AND the nominal-trend field — kills the anchor before scoring

F2-e SELECTION THINNESS: if the z-window min-6-valid rule voids > 50% of eligible decision instants on any leg class (monthly or quarterly), the cell closes BLOCKED_SELECTION — recorded as a selection failure, not mechanism evidence; unused slot never reassigned
F2-f INHERITED BASELINES: any arm failing the frozen rule_order 1..10 (p3_invariants_freeze_v9.json) fails; the family is promotable only if the anchor passes all gates AND no falsifier fires
falsification_rule.nonvacuity: if anchor trades < 40 S0-wide, or any fold has 0 anchor trades, the cell is VOID as vacuous (BLOCKED_SELECTION-class), not evidence about the mechanism

expected_failure_interpretation.F2-a_fire: the realized-inflation deviation adds nothing beyond the nominal trend at the 12m horizon either — the misalignment class closes exactly as V8's expectation class closed (by its own mandatory control)
expected_failure_interpretation.F2-b_fire: a 7-day calendar shift is informationally empty -> generic slow valuation exposure, not print-anchored mechanism; recorded as negative information, not pursued
expected_failure_interpretation.F2-c_fire: nominal momentum dominates value-driven reversion within the budget cycle (Rogoff-consistent); the frozen fade direction is wrong and a sign flip is FORBIDDEN as rescue
expected_failure_interpretation.F2-e_fire: the quarterly-leg z streams are too thin on this spot history to test the variant at all — honest BLOCKED_SELECTION, feeding the next cycle's data-staging decision
expected_failure_interpretation.gates_fail_no_falsifier: genuine mechanism-specific reversion exists but not at tradeable margins — the most likely surfaces are the break-even gate (6 bps round trip) and stress tier 2.0; the thin-margin class per P-2, recorded with margins_to_fail scaffolding

novelty_attestation.not_entered_classes: no session/open momentum or fade (event clocks and 16:00-NY closes only); no range structures; no policy-rate input anywhere; NO market-inflation-expectations series and no breakeven term-structure dispersion (V8 veto (a)) — realized CPI index levels ONLY; no vol gating; no commodity-bloc risk-off baskets; no release-window avoidance (the print instant is used for AVAILABILITY/decision timing, never for avoidance windows); no reaction-direction conditioning (the state is CPI index LEVELS and 12m spot-vs-CPI deviations, not post-print FX direction — V6/V7 class untouched); no EURUSD lead-lag (pair not funded); no USD-PC1 gating; no carry (front door closed, measured rho 0.997-1.000); V8 real-rate-FRED lane untouched (CPI index levels, not real-yield series)
novelty_attestation.v8_shadow_differentiation: the V8 measured shadow is the nominal-yield-LEVEL/nominal-trend exposure (PF 1.2268); this anchor's traded signal is the z-standardized DEVIATION FROM the PPP anchor, standardized on the deviation stream itself — when inflation explains the trend, z(m) ~= 0 and the anchor does not trade while a nominal-trend book would; mechanism = mean-reversion (fade), not trend-following; the variant differs from proposal-1 in BOTH sanctioned axes (horizon 36m -> 12m; raw bands -> z-hysteresis) giving a distinct cell, grid and falsification surface; D2 measures pooled rho vs the V8 d2 schedules AND vs the nominal-trend field (bar |rho| <= 0.20), measured never argued; the mandatory nominal-exposure control plus falsifier F2-a stand guard
novelty_attestation.sham_calendar_discharge: print instants condition the book (the decision grid IS the print-pair calendar), so the +7d sham-calendar variant is MANDATORY and occupies the neighbour slot (declared; V8 precedent)
novelty_attestation.spot_leg_disclosure: V1 snapshot lost post-close (manifest fe2155c0 records the class); Twelve Data re-acquisition SAMPLE_DEMONSTRATED; full re-staging = I-phase prerequisite with manifest-class byte verification; if re-staging fails the cycle closes BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION — a data verdict, not a family verdict
